services.name: Doors-Off Heart of the Island Kauai Tour
services.desc: Experience Kauai like never before with our doors off tour. You will feel the cool breeze as you fly by Kauai’s most beautiful landscapes– ranging from waterfalls, canyons, sea cliffs, beaches, and more. There is nothing but your camera between you and the island’s most picturesque views, making it the ideal option for photographers. Thrilling yet safe, this is the tour for those seeking to add a little adventure to their visit. Hughes MD500 Up to 4 passengers Please know we always fly a full tour with all seats sold. What you'll see As we fly clockwise around the island some highlights Up to 4 passengers • Ages 10+

services.name: Doors-On AStar Tour (60-65 Min)
services.desc: Explore Kauai from the comfort of our 6-passenger AStar, designed for providing a smooth and safe ride with all the luxuries. The aircraft is equipped with top of the line Bose noise-cancelling headphones and a plush interior. Our spacious cabin has floor to ceiling windows for optimal viewing. With all these features and an air-conditioned cabin, you will feel like a celebrity while flying around beautiful Kauai. Europter AStar Up to 6 passengers Please know we always fly a full tour with all seats sold. cancellation: Cancellation Policy: You may cancel or make changes to your booking with no obligations by notifying us at least 48 hours before your flight is scheduled to depart. “No-shows” and reservations canceled or changed within the 48-hour period before the scheduled flight time are subject to full charges.
